7.6.2.10.6 AuthenticationConfiguration
[SWS_Dcm_01533] Providing the authentication configuration ⌈If DcmDspAuthentication is configured and an Authentication (0x29) service with sub-function equal to authenticationConfiguration is received, the Dcm shall send a positive response with authenticationReturnParameter set to ’AuthenticationConfiguration APCE’.⌋(RS_Diag_04230)
